name: Aiso
description: Aiso is an AI search visibility platform that tracks how brands are mentioned and cited in ChatGPT, Gemini and other AI assistants.

events.d: Create an Aiso project for a domain; Aiso analyzes the domain and returns its setup.
List the prompts tracked in a project, optionally for one topic.
List the tracked brands of a project: your brand and its competitors.
List all projects in your Aiso account, or get one project with its full setup.
List the visibility analysis runs (snapshots) of a project.
Get mention rate, sentiment and avg position for brands in AI answers; select project, dates, filters or dimensions.
Get domains AI assistants cite for your tracked prompts with citation counts; filter by date, model, domain, or limit.
Retrieve pages AI models cite with citation counts; filter by project, model, domain, URL, date range, and dimensions.
